title: how: ground Portal chat, vault, BFF, relay, and Brain RPC document paths
description:
Ground the affected subsystem before code starts. This prevents treating the existing VaultReader JSON preview API as if it were the correct path for ONLYOFFICE binary editing.

how,pstack-playbooks
